questions.q: How many places did Petra and Martina visit in a day?
questions.e: In the video: "u jednom danu obišli četiri potpuno različita" — in one day they visited four completely different ones.
In the video: "Prvo smo posetili manastir Manasiju" — first we visited Manasija Monastery.
In the video: "smo se spustili duboko pod zemlju, u magični svet Resavske pećine." — we went deep underground, into the magical world of the Resava Cave.

questions.q: Where did they stop for lunch?
questions.e: In the video: "pauzu za ručak uz pogled na spektakularni vodopad Veliki buk" — a lunch break with a view of the spectacular Veliki Buk waterfall.

questions.q: Through which app was the trip booked?
questions.e: In the video: "Ovaj izlet smo rezervisali preko aplikacije GetYourGuide".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Evo kako je izgledao naš savršeni jednodnevni *izlet* u Srbiji.
questions.e: Izlet — a short trip, an excursion; jednodnevni — one-day.

questions.q: U jednom danu smo *obišli* četiri mesta.
questions.e: Obići — to go around, to visit (several places).

questions.q: A ti *sačuvaj* ovaj video za inspiraciju.
questions.e: Sačuvati — to save, to preserve. The form sačuvaj is the imperative.
Posetiti ("to visit") requires the accusative case. For inanimate masculine nouns it coincides with the nominative: manastir.

questions.q: Zatim smo se spustili duboko pod ___.
questions.e: Pod in answer to "where to?" requires the accusative case: pod zemlju — "underground".
After četiri the form that coincides with the genitive singular is used: četiri mesta.
The preposition preko ("via") requires the genitive case: preko aplikacije.
